title: Automatic ICP Ledger Payment Verification & Account Activation

requirements.text: Integrate the ICP Ledger canister in the backend to automatically verify incoming ICP payments. The backend actor must query the ICP Ledger (canister ID: ryjl3-tyaaa-aaaaa-aaaba-cai) to check whether a payment of at least 1 ICP has been received at the configured receiving address (eadaef90a0208bf42e25d15b9d99b767e72ed66ed1fab5b66a7799bfe88283c0). Store this address as the default/fallback if none has been set by the admin. Expose a public function `verifyAndActivate()` that any authenticated user can call: it checks the Ledger for a transfer of ≥ 1 ICP to that address where the memo or source can be associated with the calling principal, and if found, marks the user as activated.

quotes: automatische Ledger-Abfrageeinbauen, damit die Freischaltung wirklich automatisch nach Zahlungseingang passiert

acceptanceCriteria: Backend actor imports and calls the ICP Ledger canister (ryjl3-tyaaa-aaaaa-aaaba-cai) via inter-canister call.
The receiving address eadaef90a0208bf42e25d15b9d99b767e72ed66ed1fab5b66a7799bfe88283c0 is stored as the default payment address if no admin-configured address exists.
A `verifyAndActivate()` function exists that queries the Ledger for transactions to the payment address and activates the calling user's account if a qualifying payment (≥ 1 ICP) is found.
If no qualifying payment is found, the function returns an informative error rather than silently failing.
Already-activated users calling `verifyAndActivate()` receive a no-op success response.

requirements.text: Update the PaymentGate frontend component to automatically poll or trigger `verifyAndActivate()` after the user copies the payment address or clicks a 'I have paid' / 'Check Payment' button. Display a loading state while verification is in progress, a success message when the account is activated, and a clear error message (e.g., 'No payment found yet — please wait a moment and try again') if no qualifying payment is detected. The existing 30-second activation status polling (useActivationQueries) should continue so the gate dismisses automatically once activation is confirmed.

quotes: damit die Freischaltung wirklich automatisch nach Zahlungseingang passiert

acceptanceCriteria: PaymentGate shows a 'Check Payment' button that calls the backend `verifyAndActivate()` function.
A spinner / loading indicator is displayed while the verification call is in flight.
On success (account activated), the gate disappears and the user is taken to the main dashboard.
On failure, a user-friendly English error message is shown explaining that no payment was detected yet.
The existing 30-second polling for activation status remains active so the UI also auto-unlocks if payment is verified by another trigger.
The ICP receiving address eadaef90a0208bf42e25d15b9d99b767e72ed66ed1fab5b66a7799bfe88283c0 is displayed as the payment destination (used as default when no admin-configured address is set).

requirements.text: Add a `verifyAndActivate` method to the frontend actor interface and expose a corresponding React Query mutation in useActivationQueries.ts so components can call it without direct actor access.
acceptanceCriteria: The mutation calls `actor.verifyAndActivate()` and invalidates the activation-status query on success.
TypeScript types are correctly inferred from the backend Candid interface.

constraints: The ICP receiving address eadaef90a0208bf42e25d15b9d99b767e72ed66ed1fab5b66a7799bfe88283c0 must be preserved exactly as provided — do not alter or truncate it.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
All Motoko logic must remain in backend/main.mo (single-actor architecture).
Use the ICP Ledger canister ID ryjl3-tyaaa-aaaaa-aaaba-cai for mainnet Ledger calls.
nonGoals: Manual admin activation workflow — the goal is fully automatic verification.
Support for payment tokens other than ICP.
Email or SMS notifications on payment receipt.
